title: Tracking Changes of Entities
description: Learn about EntityState enumeration and how DbContext tracks entity changes.

data.text: The **ChangeTracker** property of DbContext is responsible for tracking the state of each entity. It starts tracking entities as soon as they are retrieved and keeps track of all changes.

rows: Entity is tracked but not yet in database
Entity has been modified since retrieval

data.text: Entities retrieved from queries start in Unchanged state:

data.title: Unchanged State
data.content: Retrieved entities are in Unchanged state

data.title: Added State
data.content: New entities added with Add method

data.title: Modified State
data.content: Modified entities are marked as Modified

data.title: Deleted State
data.content: Removed entities are marked as Deleted

data.text: Entities created outside DbContext scope are in Detached state:

data.title: Detached State
data.code:
var disconnectedEntity = new Student() { StudentId = 1, Name = "Bill" };
// Entity: Student, State: Detached

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Five states: Added, Modified, Deleted, Unchanged, Detached
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about advanced change tracking concepts.
